example.input: What is our parental leave policy?

input.description: Either a plain string (single user turn) or a chronological array of `USER`/`ASSISTANT` messages. The final array message must be `USER`.

stream.description: When true, the HTTP response is `text/event-stream`. When false or omitted, the HTTP response is `application/json`.

store.description: When true (default), persist the interaction and return a `conversation_id`. When false, run ephemerally with no persistence.

conversation_id.description: Continue an existing stored conversation. Incompatible with message-array `input` and with `store: false`.
